title: What Are Adaptations?
learningObjective: Students will define adaptation and identify how adaptations help animals survive

procedure.instruction: Watch the video 'Animals Are Built to Survive' to learn what adaptations are.
scaffoldingSupports: Pause to discuss: Each animal has special features
Point out: These features help them survive
Ask: 'How does a polar bear stay warm?'

procedure.instruction: View the photo gallery of 10 animals with unique adaptations.
scaffoldingSupports: Point out: Giraffe's long neck helps reach high leaves
Point out: Elephant's trunk helps grab food and water
Point out: Bird's wings help it fly away from danger

procedure.instruction: Discussion: How do polar bears stay warm in the freezing cold?
scaffoldingSupports: Guide: 'Look at its fur - it's very thick!'
Explain: 'Thick fur is an adaptation that keeps polar bears warm'

procedure.instruction: Learn vocabulary: adaptation, survive, environment, habitat.
scaffoldingSupports: Define adaptation: A special feature that helps an animal survive
Define habitat: Where an animal lives

multimediaResources.caption: Learn how animals have special features called adaptations
multimediaResources.accessibilityDescription: Video showing various animals and their unique features that help them survive

multimediaResources.caption: View 10 animals with amazing adaptations
multimediaResources.accessibilityDescription: Photo gallery featuring animals like giraffes, elephants, polar bears, and birds with labeled adaptations

exitTicket.explanation: Correct! Adaptations are special features that help animals survive in their environment.
